hits.name: systemic lupus erythematosus
hits.description: A chronic, relapsing, inflammatory, and often febrile multisystemic disorder of connective tissue, characterized principally by involvement of the skin, joints, kidneys, and serosal membranes.

hits.name: lupus nephritis
hits.description: Glomerulonephritis associated with systemic lupus erythematosus.

hits.name: cutaneous lupus erythematosus
hits.description: A form of lupus erythematosus confined to the skin.

hits.name: neonatal lupus erythematosus
hits.description: A passively acquired autoimmune disease of the newborn.
